title: Variance Capture Heatmap and Response Fingerprinting for Rollout Observability
creator: Sophie Chen
description:
Problem:
Teams currently struggle to triage subtle behavioral regressions during progressive rollouts (canary/A-B/shadow). Metric diffs capture averages but often miss distributional shifts — e.g., a small cohort of requests where the model repeats or truncates responses, or where latency spikes for a narrow slice.

Proposal Summary:
Add two complementary observability primitives to Console: (1) Variance Capture Heatmap: a per-route, per-cohort heatmap that visualizes distributional change across key dimensions (response length, token entropy proxy, latencies, repetition score) over configurable windows; (2) Response Fingerprinting: lightweight deterministic hashing and signature extraction of responses to surface high-frequency anomalous response clusters and enable rapid sample replay and trace linking.

Goals:
- Surface distributional regressions not visible in mean/median metrics.
- Provide fast links from heatmap hotspots to sampled responses, traces and payloads for forensic replay.
- Support canary/A-B/shadow traffic flows and enable comparison across cohorts.
- Keep storage and privacy costs low by storing deltas and short fingerprints rather than full payloads by default.

Non-goals:
- This ticket does not implement full-text diffing or semantic drift scoring (future work).
- Not intended to replace existing per-request tracing; it augments trace discovery.

High-level UX:
- Route-level view: heatmap overlay showing bins for latency, token-length, repetition, and entropy-proxy; selectable cohort filter (baseline, canary, shadow-sampled). Heatmap cells are clickable to open a multi-sample drawer with response fingerprints, top example snippets, and links to traces/PRs/requests.
- Cohort diff mode: side-by-side heatmap comparison with delta-highlighting and a statistical significance badge (quick p-value or bootstrap note).
- Fingerprint explorer: list of recurring fingerprints sorted by frequency and by delta between cohorts, with one-click export to shadow-replay tool and ability to pin fingerprints to a watchlist.
acceptance_criteria: Heatmap UI surfaces 4 dimensions (latency, response length, repetition-score, entropy-proxy) for any per-route rollout over a selectable 1h/6h/24h window
Heatmap cells link to a sample drawer that shows up to 10 unique fingerprinted examples and their request metadata (route, cohort, timestamp)
Response fingerprints are generated inline with serving pipeline without adding >2% p50 latency to requests in aggregate (measured on a staging fleet)
Cohort diff mode highlights cells with statistically significant divergence and allows exporting cell sample set for shadow-replay
Backend stores fingerprint indexes and lightweight aggregates using retention controls (default 7 days, configurable), and total storage delta remains under allocated quota for pilot customers
Docs and in-console help describe fingerprint generation, privacy trade-offs, and opt-out controls for sensitive routes
telemetry_schema_changes: Introduce metric groups: rollout.variance.heatmap.{route}.{cohort}.{dimension} with binned counts
New event: response.fingerprint.generated -> fields: route, cohort, fingerprint_id, sample_hash_trunc (8), length, repetition_score_bucket, entropy_bucket
Trace link field: response.fingerprint_id included in existing trace/span metadata to enable fast lookup
Retention config metadata: rollout.variance.retention_days per project
implementation_steps: Design: finalize heatmap bin definitions and fingerprint algorithm (deterministic stable hash + normalized whitespace + canonicalization) - 2 days
Schema: add telemetry metrics and event types to ingestion protocol and alerting - 1 day
Serving: implement lightweight fingerprint generation in serving path (C++/Rust runtime change) behind a feature flag - 2 weeks
Backend: index fingerprint counts and heatmap aggregates into observability store (rolling 7d windows) - 1 week
Console: implement heatmap visualization, cohort diffing, and sample drawer UI - 2 weeks
E2E: integrate trace linking and shadow-replay export; run load tests to validate latency/CPU impact - 1 week
Pilot: enable for 3 internal customers and collect feedback; iterate - 2 weeks
comments: 2025-02-12 - Miguel Ortega: Initial scoping complete. Prototype algorithm uses cityblock-normalized token frequency + Murmur3 for stable fingerprint. Need eng signoff on privacy implications.
2025-02-18 - Ayesha Patel (Design): Figma mocks uploaded. Added compact mode for dashboards to allow 3 heatmap tiles on a single row.

2025-02-21 - Rahul Das (Security): flagged that some customers route PII; recommend default opt-out per-route and a managed allowlist. Marking security review required for sensitive routes (follow-up ENG ticket needed).

2025-02-24 - Miguel Ortega: Spike results — staging serving integrated fingerprint module adds +1.3% p50 latency and +3% p95 on small rnn model; within acceptable range. Preparing ENG implementation PR.
2025-02-28 - Sophie Chen (PM): Updated acceptance criteria to include retention defaults and docs. Preparing pilot candidate list and release notes draft.
notes: Trade-offs: Full-response retention would make debugging trivial but increases storage and privacy surface area. Fingerprints + clipped snippets chosen to balance utility and cost.
Fingerprint collisions: low-probability; system surfaces collision-rate estimate and groups by example snippets to detect false merges.

Operational: will add a throttled sampler for fingerprint generation in high-throughput routes to limit overhead. Default sampler = 1/100 for public prod; customers can opt to increase for target routes.
Future: extend with semantic cluster IDs (embedding-based) if pilot shows high signal value and cost is justified.
